## Identifying different BEPs



```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof variables = Inputs.checkbox(
[ "Imaging", "Cytology", "Natera Plasma", "Natera Urine"],
{
  value: ["Imaging", "Cytology", "Natera Plasma"],
  label:"Signature components"
}
)
```


```{webr}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| input:
#|   - variables
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(gt)

print(variables)

analytic_data <- readRDS(file.path('data', 'tmp.rds'))

vars <- c(
  "Cystoscopy"="CYSTPERF",
  'Imaging'='imaging_present',
  'Cytology'="cytology_present",
  "Natera Plasma"="natera_ctdna_present",
  "Natera Urine"="natera_utdna_present"
)
vars_use <- vars[variables] # keep the variables that are selected
bl1 <- analytic_data |>
  filter(CYSTPERF=='Y') |> 
  group_by(across({{vars_use}})) |> 
  summarise(n=n()) |> 
  ungroup()
vars2 <- c(vars[variables],'treatment')
bl2 <- analytic_data |>
  filter(CYSTPERF=='Y') |> 
  group_by(across({{vars2}})) |> 
  summarise(n=n()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = n)
bl1 |> left_join(bl2) |>
  mutate(across({{variables}}, \(x) ifelse(x, "X",""))) |>
  arrange(across({{variables}}, desc)) |> 
  slice(1) |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_spanner(label="Arm", columns = c('D+G+C', 'G+C')) |> 
  cols_label(n="N") |> 
  cols_align(align='center', columns = variables)
```


::: {.panel-tabset}

## EFS

```{webr}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| input:
#|   - variables
library(ggsurvfit)
library(patchwork)


vars_use <- vars[variables]
bep_data <- analytic_data |> 
  filter(FASFL=='Y', CYSTPERF=="Y") |> 
  filter(if_all({{vars_use}}))


bep_plot <- survfit2(Surv(tte_efs, status_efs) ~ treatment, data = bep_data) |>  
  ggsurvfit() + 
  scale_ggsurvfit() + 
  annotate('text', x = 1200, y = 0.1, label = paste0("N = ", nrow(bep_data))) +
  labs(title = "BEP data")

bep_plot 
```


:::
